name: ci-health
description: Audit and optimize CI, or review proposed changes before push for inefficient execution and unnecessary complexity.

interface.longDescription: Use CI Health for performance audits, optimization, baselines, and validation. Use CI Health Preflight for change-specific reviews before push, tracing added CI work and unnecessary complexity while preserving meaningful checks. Preflight can be selected during shipping without expanding into a general audit. Includes optional read-only GitHub Actions measurement helpers.
defaultPrompt: Use $ci-health to find avoidable CI work and feedback bottlenecks, and recommend improvements while preserving required checks.
